tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands and in-flow cards on page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and inputs that sit above surface.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The one dark band per page (footer, closing call to action). Pair with ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on page, surface and surface-raised. 17:1 light, 16:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting paragraphs and descriptions on page or surface. 7.5:1 light on page, 9:1 dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, placeholders on page or surface. 5.6:1 light on page, 6.3:1 dark. Not for paragraphs.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse (footer links, small print).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Display and h1–h3 headings on page or surface. Navy is how SHERO sounds in type.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: SHERO's primary brand colour (logo navy). The main button, links, selected states. One primary button per view.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary buttons; hover colour for links.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary. 12:1 light, 8:1 dark.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: SHERO's second brand colour (logo emerald). Status and success (in stock, battery, open now, order progress), short section labels, and secondary buttons such as WhatsApp. 5.8:1 light, 9:1 dark. Never body text.

tokens.name: secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for secondary buttons.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: secondary-subtle
tokens.usage: Background for Live badges and success notes; pair with secondary text.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Background for neutral status badges (In validation); pair with primary text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: In development status text and warnings, on warning-subtle. 6.2:1 light, 9.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Background for In development badges and warning notes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive actions, form validation messages on page.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background for error notes; pair with danger.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default hairline: cards, dividers, table rules. Structure, not decoration.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and secondary button outlines; 3:1 against page for control boundaries.

tokens.name: border-inverse
tokens.usage: Dividers on surface-inverse (the footer).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element.
